title: Stage 4 Evaluator Output
description: Schema for the evaluator stage output. Returns PASS/NEEDS_WORK verdict, structured findings tied to upstream artifact IDs, coverage metrics, and a mandatory honesty field listing what was not evaluated.

verdict.description: PASS iff critical==0 AND high==0 AND coverage.reqs_covered/reqs_total >= 0.8 (or reqs_total==0 and risks coverage >= 0.8). Otherwise NEEDS_WORK.

findings.description: Structured findings tied to upstream artifact IDs. Empty array is valid for a PASS verdict.

id.description: Finding identifier in the form EVAL-NNN (zero-padded three digits)

category.description: Bounded category — exactly these five. Adding a new category requires a tracked commit to evaluator-agent.md.

severity.description: Severity of the finding. critical/high findings cause NEEDS_WORK verdict regardless of coverage.

referenced_artifact.description: Which upstream artifact this finding references

referenced_id.description: ID of the specific item in the referenced artifact (e.g., REQ-001, ATK-003, RISK-005)

description.description: Concrete description of what is missing, weak, or misaligned

suggested_remediation.description: Actionable remediation suggestion for the solutions-agent on a re-run

coverage.description: Coverage metrics computed from upstream artifacts

reqs_covered.description: Number of REQ-* (defensive) or ATK-* (offensive) items that have at least one SOL-* addressing them

reqs_total.description: Total REQ-* or ATK-* items in the Stage 1 artifact

risks_addressed.description: Number of RISK-* items that have at least one SOL-* targeting them

risks_total.description: Total RISK-* items in the Stage 2 artifact

p0_sols_count.description: Number of P0-priority solutions in SOLUTIONS.json

unevaluated.description: Mandatory honesty field: name what was NOT evaluated (e.g., runtime behavior, third-party deps, side channels). Must be at least 20 characters — 'none' or 'n/a' are not acceptable.

summary.description: Aggregate summary used by the orchestrator to route to the next step

findings_count_by_severity.description: Count of findings at each severity level

decision_rationale.description: One-paragraph explanation of why the verdict is PASS or NEEDS_WORK, referencing specific finding IDs or coverage ratios

stage_summary.description: 200-word-max summary covering verdict, key findings, coverage metrics, and residual gaps not captured as formal findings
